title: Expected Cost of a Bind
statement: Let $p$ be a probability mass function on a type $\gamma$, and for each $a \in \gamma$ let $f(a)$ be a probability mass function on pairs $(b,n)$, where $n$ is a natural number. The expected second coordinate under the distribution obtained by first sampling $a$ from $p$ and then sampling from $f(a)$ equals $\sum_a p(a)\,\mathbb{E}_{f(a)}[n]$, with expectations and sums taken in the nonnegative extended reals.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\gamma$
$f$ assigns a probability mass function on $\beta \times \mathbb{N}$ to each $a \in \gamma$
